name: dsp_biquads
description: footstep-id dsp: each entry one 2nd-order Butterworth biquad (DSP_FILTER_FAMILY/ORDER; RBJ cookbook, Q = 1/sqrt(2), computed in double, normalised by a0, rounded to float32), transposed direct form II in float32, zero state: y = z0 + b0*x; z0 = (z1 + b1*x) - a1*y; z1 = b2*x - a2*y. Input = the decimated clip; expected[i] = output after section i. masked: the same input with valid = false at the lost (invalid) samples; every section skips them: no state update, output 0, and the input value there is ignored (it is not zero).
build: Firmware builds the dsp/trigger sources with -ffp-contract=off (no fused multiply-add).

tolerance.note: abs, every section, both cases = 10x the larger of the FMA-emulation and float64-reference errors (the 5 Hz high-pass on the clip's DC offset dominates).
